name: LongStory
source:
When the previous owner of Locker 1224 mysteriously disappeared, you were left holding the only clues.
As a new student to the truly bizarre Weasel Heights, you must navigate the school’s social landscape through your decisions and conversations. Make new friends and face old enemies to work out exactly what happened - and if there’s anything you can do to put it right.

If you work up the nerve to ask your crush on a date, there are five romanceable characters in LongStory: Two girls, two boys, and one… well, you’ll have to wait and see. It's gonna be a long story. 

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.to.bloomdigital.longstorygame01]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
当1224号储物柜的前主人神秘失踪时，你只剩下唯一的线索。
作为来到真正奇异的黄鼠狼高地的新生，你必须通过你的决定和对话来驾驭学校的社会景观。结交新朋友，面对老敌人，弄清楚到底发生了什么——以及你是否可以做些什么来纠正它。

如果你鼓起勇气向心仪的对象约会，《长篇故事》中有五个浪漫的角色：两个女孩，两个男孩，还有一个……好吧，你得等着瞧。这将是一个很长的故事。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.to.bloomdigital.longstorygame01]谷歌游戏[/url]]
